name: SearchForm

props.description: One FormField per condition, in reading order. Each direct child is one grid cell; a range (「日付」 From〜To, 「金額」 「下限〜上限」) is ONE FormField holding both controls.
props.name: children

props.description: Grid columns per container breakpoint — one column on a phone, aligned columns above. Conditions never spread to the edges.
props.name: columns

props.description: Conditions shown while collapsed (antd `defaultFormItemsNumber`). Default: the widest `columns` step, i.e. the first row.
props.name: visibleFields

props.description: Controlled: whether the conditions past `visibleFields` are shown.
props.name: open

props.description: Uncontrolled initial state — collapsed to the first row by default.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: Fires when the 「詳細条件を開く」 / 「閉じる」 toggle is pressed.
props.name: onOpenChange

props.description: Search (「検索」) — the native form submit. Call `preventDefault()` and copy the draft conditions into the applied query; the form never searches on each keystroke.
props.name: onSubmit

props.description: Clear (「クリア」). The button renders only when this is set.
props.name: onReset

props.description: The conditions the CURRENT results were searched with, shown after the localized 「検索条件」 label in the status line (e.g. 「国「籍」: 「ベトナム」 / 「状態」: 「実習」中」).
props.name: summary

props.description: Localized, pluralized result count in the same `role="status"` line.
props.name: resultCount

props.description: Puts the Search button in its loading state while the query runs.
props.name: loading

props.description: Overrides the localized Search (「検索」) text.
props.name: searchLabel

props.description: Overrides the localized Clear (「クリア」) text.
props.name: resetLabel

props.description: Accessible name of the `search` landmark (default: localized 'Search conditions').
props.name: label

props.description: Passed to the underlying Form: `layout="vertical"` (default) is label-top; `layout="horizontal"` + `labelWidth` is the label-left table style of Japanese business systems. Set `controlWidth` once here so Selects fill their column.
props.name: layout / labelWidth / controlWidth / labelAlign

related: Toolbar — FilterBar, the live filter strip; use it for a few filters applied as the user changes them.
Form — the layout container SearchForm renders (`role="search"`); its `layout`, `labelWidth` and `controlWidth` pass through.
FormField — one per condition; a range is one FormField holding two controls.
DataTable — the results under the form.
tagline: Submit-driven 「検索条件フォーム」 (Ant Design ProComponents QueryFilter): a `search` landmark holding a grid of labelled conditions aligned in columns, Search 「検索」 + Clear 「クリア」, the conditions past the first row behind ONE 「詳細条件を開く」 toggle that names how many are hidden, and a 「検索条件」 summary + result count in a role="status" line after the search. Use it instead of a live FilterBar when the conditions are many, the query is heavy, or users expect an explicit 「検索」 button (rule #51 decision table).
usage: DO pick the shape from rule #51's decision table: a few filters applied instantly → FilterBar; many conditions / a heavy query / users who expect an explicit 「検索」 button → SearchForm; arbitrary field × operator conditions saved as views → pattern `condition-builder`.
DO put one FormField per condition as a direct child. Ranges (「入国日」 From〜To, 「金額」 「下限〜上限」) are ONE FormField with both controls; 「部分一致」 / 「完全一致」 is a RadioGroup inside the name field.

DO keep a draft and an applied copy of the conditions: inputs edit the draft, onSubmit copies it to the applied query, onReset clears both. Pass the applied conditions as `summary` and the hit count as `resultCount`.

DO NOT wrap it in another Form, and do not rebuild it as a Form + ResponsiveGrid + Collapsible by hand — the collapse, the hidden-count toggle, the search landmark and the status line are what this component owns. Hidden conditions stay mounted, so a typed value survives collapsing.

A SearchForm (or any `<Form role="search" onSubmit>`) above a table is NOT flagged by ui-audit `form-on-list-page` or `hand-rolled-filter-bar`; a submitting create form without role="search" still is.
useCases: 「検索条件フォーム」 on a Japanese business-system list (「基幹系」 / 「業務システム」): 6–12 conditions, 「検索」 and 「クリア」 buttons, 「詳細条件を開く」.
Search screens over a heavy query where searching on every keystroke would be too expensive.
Label-left (「表形式」) or label-top search panels above a DataTable, with the applied conditions summarized after the search.
